runtime_policy: Never treat a planned concept as an active canonical record or a valid rule dependency.

items.next_research: Find primary business-school methods and OECD/World Bank data methodology; define bottom-up unit/population assumptions and uncertainty, not a single market-size number.
Read accessible originator/publisher primary text, then add contextual framework records; do not infer full TOWS from SWOT.
Establish accounting jurisdiction and currency conventions, retrieve local authoritative guidance and current data, then identify unit-economics adaptations.
Research source-authored methods and causal limitations; build model-specific metric contracts and diagnosis trees.
Read primary empirical studies and author-hosted methods; separate detection from causal intervention, retain stakeholder evidence.
Contrast author models with independent studies; specify failure cases, resource constraints and stopping rules.
Review official NIST revision status and full 600-1 plus recent primary experiments. Distinguish task speed, quality, cost and organizational outcomes.
For each symptom, define comparable measure, missing-data gate, competing hypotheses, evidence tests, contextual actions, sources and no-action outcome.
Use six supplied personas in real observed sessions; predefine relevance, time, unsupported recommendation and uncertainty communication criteria before testing.
